glossary.definition: "340B covered entity" means an entity described in section 340B(a)(4) of the "Public Health Service Act," 42 U.S.C. 256b(a)(4).
"340B drug" means a covered outpatient drug that has been subject to discount pricing under the 340B drug pricing program and is purchased by a 340B covered entity.
"340B drug pricing program" means the federal drug pricing program established under 42 U.S.C. 256b.
